title: 036 · Collection of four labelled cartons
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Fesk Rowan, shipping coordinator at Orris Fold Studio. From the case card: the business shipper needs collection capacity for four labelled cartons, and collection planning controls vehicle allocation and manifest acceptance.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get capacity for all four cartons, a collection booking and one manifest confirmed by the collection planner.

sender.name: Fesk Rowan
sender.responsibility: Provide the carton details and require that all four cartons are collected together.
source_names: Fesk Rowan, Orris Fold Studio shipping coordinator

planner.name: Collection planner
planner.responsibility: Allocate vehicle capacity, book the collection and accept the manifest for all four cartons.

goal: Get the collection planner to confirm a collection booking with capacity for all four OF-036 cartons together and accept them on one manifest.
limits: Do not treat the capacity reservation as proof of collection.
Do not treat the accepted manifest as proof of collection.

intake.summary: Confirm that one collection vehicle can take all four labelled OF-036 cartons together.
intake.note: Creation time is taken from the case card. The history has no separate system event for ticket creation.

initial.blocker: No collection capacity is confirmed for the four cartons.

facts.text: The business shipper needs capacity for four labelled cartons.
Collection planning controls vehicle allocation and manifest acceptance.

success_criteria.description: The collection planner has confirmed capacity for all four cartons together.
The collection planner has confirmed the collection booking.
The collection planner has accepted all four cartons on one manifest.

agent_state.next_action: Take in incoming information on the case.

steps.label: Packing list
steps.title: Sender shares packing list OF-036
steps.explanation: We now have the carton count, sizes, weights, labels and the ready time. That is what collection planning needs to allocate a vehicle.

facts_upsert.text: Inline packing list OF-036: 4 labelled cartons, each 40 × 30 × 25 cm and 5 kg, total 20 kg.
The cartons are ready at dispatch door S1 from 10:00 UTC on 2026-03-10.

agent_state.next_action: Get collection planning to confirm capacity for the four cartons.

steps.blocker: No collection capacity is confirmed for the four cartons.

next_step.description: Request collection capacity for the four cartons from collection planning.

steps.label: Client request
steps.title: Fesk asks for one vehicle for all four
steps.explanation: The sender will not release a partial consignment, so capacity has to cover all four cartons at once. Only the collection planner can confirm that, so the next step is a request to the planner.

facts_upsert.text: The sender cannot release a partial consignment.

r0.purpose: Confirm a collection vehicle can take all four cartons together.
r0.expected_response: Confirmation that all four cartons fit on one collection.

r1.purpose: Confirm capacity for all four cartons together and book their collection.
r1.expected_response: Collection booking with capacity for all four cartons.

agent_state.next_action: Ask the collection planner to confirm capacity for the four cartons with their sizes and weights.

steps.blocker: No collection capacity is confirmed; a partial collection is not acceptable to the sender.

next_step.description: Confirm capacity for all four cartons and book the collection.

steps.label: Our request
steps.title: We request capacity and one manifest
steps.explanation: We gave the planner the carton count, sizes, weights, time and door, and asked for cartons A–D on one manifest. Now we wait for the planner's confirmation.

r1.purpose: Confirm capacity for all four OF-036 cartons (each 40 × 30 × 25 cm, 5 kg; total 20 kg) and book collection on 2026-03-10 from 10:00 UTC at dispatch door S1.
r1.expected_response: Collection booking with capacity for all four cartons.

r2.purpose: Accept cartons A–D as one manifest.
r2.expected_response: Accepted manifest listing all four cartons.

waiting_for.expected: Collection booking with capacity for all four cartons

agent_state.next_action: Once the planner replies, check that capacity, booking and manifest cover all four cartons.

steps.blocker: Capacity, booking and manifest are not yet confirmed.

next_step.description: Wait for the planner to confirm capacity, the booking and the single manifest.

steps.label: Confirmation
steps.title: Planner confirms booking COL-036 and manifest MN-036
steps.explanation: Capacity for all four cartons is reserved, the collection is booked and one manifest lists A to D, so the coordination task is closed. The pickup itself has not happened.

facts_upsert.text: Capacity is reserved for all four cartons, 20 kg total.
Booking COL-036 is confirmed for 2026-03-10, 10:00–12:00 UTC.
Inline accepted manifest MN-036 lists DL-036-A, B, C and D.

r0.purpose: Confirm a collection vehicle can take all four cartons together.
r0.expected_response: Confirmation that all four cartons fit on one collection.
r0.response: Capacity reserved for all four cartons, 20 kg total, under booking COL-036.

r1.purpose: Confirm capacity for all four OF-036 cartons (each 40 × 30 × 25 cm, 5 kg; total 20 kg) and book collection on 2026-03-10 from 10:00 UTC at dispatch door S1.
r1.expected_response: Collection booking with capacity for all four cartons.
r1.response: Booking COL-036 confirmed for 2026-03-10, 10:00–12:00 UTC; capacity reserved for all four cartons, 20 kg total.
